name: finshield-git-agent
description: FinShield Git Automation MCP Server for automated branching, committing, pushing, and repository synchronization.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Get current git branch, staged files, unstaged changes, untracked files, and remote status in structured JSON.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Stage all changes and create a conventional formatted commit.

type.description: Type e.g. feat, fix, chore, docs

tools.name: git_branch
tools.description: Create and checkout a new branch for feature isolation.

name.description: Branch name to create or switch to

tools.name: git_sync
tools.description: Stage, commit, pull latest changes and push upstream to remote in one operation.

tools.name: git_set_remote
tools.description: Set or update GitHub remote origin URL.

tools.name: git_pull
tools.description: Pull latest changes from remote repository.
